tie_rule: Non-finals playoff MATCH tied: the win goes to the ALLIANCE per Table 10-3, in order: 1st cumulative TECH FOUL points due to opponent rule violations; 2nd ALLIANCE AUTO points; 3rd ALLIANCE STAGE points; 4th MATCH is replayed (§10.6.2.1, pp.123-124). Finals: a tied Finals MATCH remains a tie; if no ALLIANCE has 2 wins after 3 Finals MATCHES, up to 3 Overtime MATCHES are played, and a tied Overtime MATCH is decided by Table 10-3 (§10.6.2.2, p.124). Einstein Finals: a tied MATCH is replayed (§12.4, p.138). Source: 2024 Game Manual final PDF; Team Update 04 (2024-01-19) set the 3rd criterion as 'ALLIANCE PARK, ONSTAGE, and NOTE in TRAP STAGE points'.
